trigger: Interact with Ray in his garage.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ray's garage glows. A generator chugs. Three red jerry cans, a radio, a shotgun on a hook.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Yah. Dell. Close the door, you're letting the money out.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: If this is about Pruitt, I already said. Can't run the whole block off one Honda.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: You want diesel, I want something worth diesel. That's the economy now.

choices.text: You could just help people, Ray.
Where'd you get this much fuel?

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Cash is toilet paper. Guns, tools, meds. Your klein set and your hot sticks? That's a jug.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Good steel. Five-gallon jug. We're square.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: My dad's tools. Don't sell them on.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Yah, no. I'll keep 'em oiled. You'll want 'em back.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: I am helping. I'm helping me. Somebody's gotta be ready when the help runs out.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Pruitt's eighty-four. I got a kid out there somewhere. Twenty-seven.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Cody. We don't talk. That's the whole story.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: If he shows up, he's gonna want heat. So the diesel stays.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The cans still have Kwik Trip price stickers. Dated Day 2.

choices.text: Those are from the Kwik Trip, Ray.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: Tanks were sitting there. Nobody organized nothing. Somebody had to.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: You gonna tell the Guard? Go ahead. They'd take it and give it to nobody.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The door clunks shut behind you. The generator keeps on.
